map.马后炮杀法步骤演练: Knight mate (ma hou pao) steps worked example
map.输入某残局，工具展示马控将门、炮借马威将军的着法序列，输出「马八进七—炮九平四」: Entering a position, the tool shows the move sequence of the horse controlling the check and the cannon borrowing the horse's power, outputs steps such as "horse from eight to seven — cannon from nine to four" and judges it a one-move mate, noting to watch for the opponent interposing a piece to defuse the check.
map.一步杀怎么判定？: How is a one-move mate determined?
map.从将军着法倒推，确认对方无论怎么解将（垫将/避将/吃子）均无效，即一步杀。: Work backward from the checking move and confirm that no check evasion (interposition / avoidance / capture) works, which makes it a one-move mate.
map.江湖残局特点？: What are the characteristics of jianghu endgames?
map.子力少、陷阱多、和棋率高，常需精确着法，误着即败或和，适合练算度。: Few pieces, many traps and a high draw rate; they usually require precise moves, and one mistake loses or draws, so they suit training calculation.
map.常见杀法有哪些？: What are the common mating patterns?
map.马后炮、重炮、闷宫、双车错、卧槽马、挂角马、铁门栓、天地炮等，多为车马炮协同成杀: The knight mate, double cannon, smothered palace, double-chariot, crouching horse, corner horse, iron gate bolt and heaven-and-earth cannon, mostly formed by coordinated chariot, horse and cannon.
